plan.title: bug(session,cli): gated ritual failure never surfaces the session:ready one-shot -- recovery line is hook-path only

narratives.Description: bug(session,cli): gated ritual failure never surfaces the session:ready one-shot -- recovery line is hook-path only
narratives.Overview:
**TL;DR: `verify:session-ritual --tier=gated` computes `recoveryTier`, and the framework already has a one-shot recovery line naming `deft session:ready` — but the direct CLI path prints neither. Only the PreToolUse hook path emits it. AGENTS.md tells agents to run the ritual command directly, so they see the cache-level `cache fetch-all` hint and hand-roll the two-step recovery. Reported in #3500.**

## What happens

1. `verifySessionRitual(root, {tier:"gated"})` runs the `cache_fresh` gated entrypoint inline — `packages/core/src/session/verify-session-ritual.ts:45-49`.
2. `verify:cache-fresh` fails (age or drift). The recorded step message is the cache-level text ending in ``Recovery: run `deft cache fetch-all …` `` — `packages/core/src/preflight-cache/evaluate.ts:340-348`, `:551-561`.
3. `evaluateLoadedState` returns `code: 1` with `recoveryTier: "cold"` — `verify-session-ritual.ts:246-256`.
4. The CLI writes `result.message` to stderr and stops — `packages/cli/src/verify-session-ritual.ts:117`. `formatRitualRecoveryInstruction()` is never called, and `emitVerifyJson` omits `recovery_tier`.

`formatRitualRecoveryInstruction("cold")` returns exactly the line that would have prevented the redo:

> Recovery: run `deft session:ready` (one-shot: session:start + gated ritual + cache recovery as needed).

Its only non-test caller is the hook dispatcher — `packages/core/src/hooks/dispatcher.ts:919`.

## Why it matters

`deft session:ready` (#2993) already composes fetch-all + re-verify in one verb. The capability shipped; the pointer never reached the surface operators actually use. #3500 reports the cost as a full stop plus a manual redo — avoidable with existing machinery, no gate weakened.

Second order: the consumer deposit entry names `session:start` and `verify:session-ritual` but never `session:ready` — `content/templates/agents-entry.md:19`. A consumer agent has no path to discover it.

## Acceptance -- 2 clauses

Two surfaces, one root cause. Both clauses are in scope for this issue; expected as **one PR** (~60 lines across three files). ⊗ Close on clause 1 alone -- that is a false green on #3500.

### Clause 1 -- CLI surface emits the recovery line

`packages/cli/src/verify-session-ritual.ts` -- on non-zero exit, append `formatRitualRecoveryInstruction(result.recoveryTier ?? "cold")` to the stderr write. Add `recovery_tier` to `emitVerifyJson` (`packages/core/src/session/verify-session-ritual.ts:603`).

Also unconditional copy: when `cache_fresh` is the failing gated step, name the sanctioned soft path (`deft session:start -- --defer cache_fresh=<reason>`, audited) alongside the fetch-all hint. **No branch required** -- the gated argv is the constant `["verify:cache-fresh"]` (`verify-session-ritual.ts:45-49`), so `--for-issue` is never present at this boundary. (An earlier draft of this issue implied a conditional; see the correction on #3507.)

Verify:

```
deft verify:session-ritual -- --tier=gated
deft verify:session-ritual -- --tier=gated --json
```

- Non-zero exit on `cache_fresh` prints the `deft session:ready` one-shot recovery line.
- `--json` carries `recovery_tier`.
- New test asserts the recovery line on the direct CLI path. No test covers this today, which is how the hook path and the direct path diverged silently (`test-debt`).

### Clause 2 -- consumer deposit names the one-shot

`content/templates/agents-entry.md` -- add the `deft session:ready` pointer to the #1149 ritual line, then `task agents:refresh`. Mirror into `AGENTS.md` per #1309.

Verify:

```
task agents:refresh
pnpm exec vitest run packages/core/src/content-contracts/skills/agents_entry_contract.test.ts
```

- `agents-entry.md` names `deft session:ready`; `agents_entry_contract` marker list updated (`pointerHints` on `id: "session-ritual-1149"`, and the `deft`/`task` pair in `PROPAGATION_COMMAND_MARKERS` if the dual surface applies).
- Deposit regenerates clean; no `agents_entry_contract` failures.

**Sizing note.** 2 clauses -> size M under #3323/#3358 evidence. Clause 1 is Low, clause 2 is Medium (961-line contract test; per-section coupling unverified). If clause 2 proves worse than Medium, split it out **then** as a follow-up child of #3500 -- ⊗ pre-split on speculation.

⊗ Do not auto-defer `cache_fresh` -- `packages/core/src/policy/ceremony-dial.ts:129-133`. This issue is surfacing and copy, not gate relaxation.

## Partial delivery -- clause 1 may merge alone

Clause 1 is Low complexity and delivers the whole of #3500's reported relief. It MAY ship in its own PR, ahead of clause 2, while this issue stays OPEN.

**Worker contract for a clause-1-only PR:**

1. PR body uses `Tracking: #3506` (or `Refs #3506`). ⊗ `Closes` / `Fixes` / `Resolves`.
2. Run `task pr:check-closing-keywords` before push. Non-zero exit is a **hard refusal** -- rewrite the body/commits until clean (`commands.md` § pre-PR; #737 / #3015 intent mode). Real closing keywords require CLI `--allow-close`; body trailers are not an authorization path.
3. ⊗ `task scope:complete`. The story xBRIEF stays in `xbrief/active/` at `plan.status: running` for clause 2. One story, two merges, one completion.

⊗ Write a conditional closing keyword such as `Closes #3506 (clause 1 only)` / `Closes #3506 Phase A`. GitHub ignores the qualifier and auto-closes, orphaning clause 2 -- the recurring incident class this gate exists for (`content/skills/deft-directive-pre-pr/SKILL.md:151`, `:236`; prior incidents #697, #401, #700, #735 each needed manual reopen).

**Why this issue is not split into two children.** Nothing about partial delivery requires it. Parent #3500 auto-closes on `ALL_CHILDREN_MERGED` via the umbrella reconcile path (`packages/core/src/vbrief-reconcile/umbrellas.ts:764`), which is **child-granular, not clause-granular** -- so a clause-1-only merge correctly leaves this issue open and the epic untouched, with no configuration. Two children would instead let #3500 close with clause 2 landed as a separate green, losing the fact that both clauses are one defect on two surfaces.

Relates #3500 (parent), #2993 (`session:ready`), #1149 (ritual), #1309 (propagation), #3214 (do-not-defer anchor), #3507 (argv correction).

### Comment by @MScottAdams (2026-08-19T16:24:29Z)

## Body edited: acceptance restructured into 2 explicit clauses

Flagging because a silent body edit does not notify watchers.

- **Clause 1** -- CLI surface emits the recovery line (`recovery_tier` in `--json`, plus the `--defer` soft-path copy). Low.
- **Clause 2** -- consumer deposit names the one-shot (`agents-entry.md` + `agents:refresh` + marker list, #1309). Medium.

Both stay in this issue, expected as one PR (~60 lines / three files). Rationale: one defect on two surfaces -- the pointer exists and reaches only one of its two call sites -- so splitting by surface leaves two issues that each read as partial, and clause 2 is the half that gets orphaned. Stamped clause count 2 -> size M for the #3323 / #3358 evidence path.

Also corrected in the body: the "Fix" step that said *when no `--for-issue` was supplied* implied a conditional. The gated argv is the constant `["verify:cache-fresh"]` (`packages/core/src/session/verify-session-ritual.ts:45-49`), so `--for-issue` is never present at this boundary and the copy is unconditional -- no branch to write. Same root finding as the correction on #3507.

⊗ Close on clause 1 alone.


### Comment by @MScottAdams (2026-08-19T16:34:45Z)

## Body edited: added a "Partial delivery" section

Flagging because a silent body edit does not notify watchers.

**Clause 1 may now ship in its own PR ahead of clause 2, with this issue staying OPEN.** Clause 1 is Low complexity and carries the whole of #3500's reported relief, so there is a real gain in not waiting for the contract-gated half.

The worker contract is three lines: `Tracking: #3506` not `Closes`; `task pr:check-closing-keywords` treated as a hard refusal before push; no `scope:complete` until clause 2. Full text and the incident rationale are in the body.

This does **not** change the earlier call to keep both clauses in one issue -- the reasoning is recorded in the new section. Parent #3500's umbrella auto-close is child-granular (`ALL_CHILDREN_MERGED`), so a clause-1-only merge leaves this issue and the epic in the correct state with no configuration.
